rounds.strongest_objection: A perfect ordinary undo has unspecified coherent phases on the moving and idle words. Those phases change the compensated observation. rounds.design_response: Request a calibrated reference or an explicit invariant of the combined pulse and undo phases, a real probe on the fourth word, controls on a physical log, and a separation of unions of guarded alternatives from jointly active physical systems.

rounds.strongest_objection: When each recoder or reference is free, only the phase around a complete sequence can be identified. Equality of end words supplies no such phase reference.
rounds.design_response: Compare the original compensation with direct recombination of the moving and idle alternatives. Keep a separate control that varies the active reference, the recoder, the clock, and the coupling of the fourth word.

rounds.strongest_objection: A decoration on one of three interchangeable leaves represents three named possibilities. A decoration at the centre represents one. A list of different shapes alone loses the labelled probability mass.
rounds.design_response: Use exact decorated orbit multiplicities, check each undecorated group against all labelled Prüfer words, check every count of extra distinctions separately and independently replay both laws including funding stalls and two-place closures.
